title: YouTube AdFree
shortDescription: Development build with targeted ad-playback and entity diagnostics plus hardened ad blocking.
description: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. It keeps the release ad-blocking, Shorts-removal, sponsored-overlay, and playback-hook hardening. DEV diagnostics now pin every exact isAdPlayback boolean with its value, response shape, nearest player response, and immediate before/after response summaries; they also name framework payload entity types such as qrCodeEntity and retain only safe schema hints. The broad structural inventories remain available, with camel-case token matching to avoid false ad signals from unrelated keys such as payload, readahead, and adaptiveFormats. Blue opens the frozen paged report and advances one page per press; Back is the only way to close it.

added: Dedicated AD PLAYBACK EVENTS diagnostics that record the exact isAdPlayback boolean value, object path, top-level response keys, nearest player response, and bounded before/after response summaries.
Dedicated ENTITY PAYLOAD EVENTS diagnostics that identify named framework payload objects such as qrCodeEntity and preserve safe style/layout hints without retaining arbitrary payload strings.
Association of later entity updates with the most recently observed ad-playback event so an interactive ad flow can be reconstructed from photographs.
changed: Ad/promo signal detection now tokenizes camel-case key names instead of substring-matching, preventing false positives from payload, readahead, adaptiveFormats, and similar unrelated keys.
The safe scalar-hint allowlist now includes isAdPlayback so its true/false value is visible in response profiles.
Blue-button photograph-sized pagination and Back-only exit remain unchanged; development branding continues to invert final launcher and Homebrew Channel icon colors.
fixed: DEV diagnostics previously proving that isAdPlayback existed but discarding the boolean value needed to distinguish real ad playback from a negative state notification.
Generic payload and read-ahead/player-buffer keys polluting the ad/masthead/promo signal inventory because their spelling happened to contain the letters ad.
Sponsored Home masthead and feed ads escaping the known-renderer filter during fresh app loads or alternate response schemas remain observable without deleting unknown structures blindly.
